indicators.name: Error Level Analysis (ELA) Compression Variance
indicators.mechanism: JPEG compression saves images in 8x8 pixel blocks at a uniform error level. When an image is spliced or modified, the edited regions have a differing compression error rate compared to untouched areas.
indicators.detectionProtocol: Resave the image at 95% JPEG quality and compute the absolute difference matrix between the original and resaved pixels. High-contrast white glow highlights modified regions.
visualTells: Bright glowing edges around isolated subjects inserted into a dimmer background
Discrepancies in high-frequency noise textures across object boundaries
Mismatched JPEG grid alignment across composite layers

indicators.name: Frequency Domain (FFT) & GAN Checkerboard Artifacts
indicators.mechanism: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) and diffusion models leave distinct periodic grid patterns in the 2D Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) power spectrum due to transposed convolution upsampling operations.
indicators.detectionProtocol: Transform the image luminance channel into frequency space via 2D FFT. Inspect the logarithmic power spectrum for unnatural symmetric starburst spikes or periodic grid peaks.
visualTells: Symmetric cross-shaped or circular harmonic spikes in the Fourier magnitude spectrum
Absence of natural 1/f spatial frequency decay curves
Sub-pixel periodic lattice patterns visible under high-pass filtering

indicators.name: Shadow & Specular Light Vector Inconsistency
indicators.mechanism: In genuine physical scenes, all cast shadows and eye corneal specular reflections must converge toward common physical light sources (the sun or artificial fixtures). AI-generated composites frequently generate conflicting light angles.
indicators.detectionProtocol: Draw linear ray vectors from shadow tips through object anchor points. Triangulate vanishing points and compare with corneal catchlight highlights in subjects' eyes.
visualTells: Shadows of adjacent figures falling at contradictory 45-degree opposing angles
Irregular corneal catchlight shapes (e.g., square reflection outdoors on an overcast day)
Absence of contact ambient occlusion shadows beneath human feet or vehicle tires

indicators.name: Anatomical & Fine Structure Geometric Anomalies
indicators.mechanism: Diffusion architectures struggle with complex continuous geometric constraints, producing subtle topological defects in human extremities, teeth, jewelry, text glyphs, and architectural symmetry.
indicators.detectionProtocol: Execute high-magnification optical inspection on fingers, earlobes, iris pupil boundaries, garment buttonholes, and background architectural lines.
visualTells: Polydactyly (6 fingers) or syndactyly (merged knuckles and fused nails)
Earrings with mismatched geometry or earlobes melting into jawlines
Asymmetrical pupil contours (non-circular, notched pupil perimeters)
Gibberish or pseudo-Cyrillic glyphs on street signs and nameplates

indicators.name: EXIF & File Header Structural Integrity
indicators.mechanism: Raw digital camera images contain comprehensive EXIF/TIFF headers, camera serial numbers, lens focal lengths, and thumbnail previews. Generative AI tools and social scrapers produce bare, truncated, or inconsistent metadata streams.
indicators.detectionProtocol: Parse raw binary byte headers using ExifTool. Check for presence of MakerNotes, IFD0 pointers, JPEG quantization tables, and C2PA provenance signatures.
visualTells: Missing camera serial number and lens make/model tags
Software tag labeled with known generative pipelines (e.g., 'Stable Diffusion WebUI')
Discrepancy between embedded thumbnail image and primary full-resolution bitmap

indicators.name: Vocal Spectral Envelope Cutoff & Harmonic Void
indicators.mechanism: Neural vocoders (e.g., HiFi-GAN, WaveNet) typically operate at fixed sample rates (e.g., 22.05kHz or 24kHz), introducing a sharp brick-wall frequency cutoff at the Nyquist boundary (11kHz to 12kHz) with empty upper harmonics.
indicators.detectionProtocol: Generate a high-resolution linear spectrogram (FFT size 2048). Inspect upper frequency spectrum above 10kHz for unnatural zero-energy cliffs or synthetic white noise padding.
visualTells: Sharp horizontal line of zero acoustic energy above 11.025kHz or 12kHz
Absence of natural high-frequency breath fricatives (s, sh, f sounds)
Unnaturally rigid harmonic overtone combs without micro-pitch modulations

indicators.name: Acoustic Environment & Reverberation Discontinuity
indicators.mechanism: Real-world acoustic environments impose specific room impulse response (RT60 reverberation) across speech and background sounds. Cloned voice tracks pasted over atmospheric noise lack matched room acoustics.
indicators.detectionProtocol: Measure the room reverberation decay time (RT60) during speech pauses versus background noise intervals using impulse response deconvolution.
visualTells: Completely dry vocal track (RT60 = 0.0s) heard inside a large reverberant hall or cathedral
Abrupt silence cutoffs between words where synthetic noise gating drops to digital zero
Mismatched stereo spatialization (mono voice centered over wide binaural background)

indicators.name: Phoneme Jitter, Shimmer & Micro-Prosody Loss
indicators.mechanism: Human vocal fold vibration exhibits natural cycle-to-cycle variation in fundamental frequency (jitter) and amplitude (shimmer). Neural text-to-speech models produce unnaturally steady pitch contours lacking micro-prosodic tremors.
indicators.detectionProtocol: Extract the fundamental frequency contour (F0) using Praat. Calculate percent pitch jitter and amplitude shimmer across sustained vowel phonemes.
visualTells: Pitch jitter < 0.1% during emotional shouting (human emotional speech exhibits 1.5% to 3.5% jitter)
Robotic, flat intonation curves on sentence question endings
Lack of physiological breath intake pauses before long 20-word clauses

indicators.name: Glottal Pulse Shape & Phase Coherence Anomalies
indicators.mechanism: Human vocal production is driven by asymmetric physical opening and rapid closing of vocal cords. Neural vocoders generate acoustic waveforms via mathematical filters that alter glottal pulse phase coherence.
indicators.detectionProtocol: Apply inverse vocal tract filtering to isolate the glottal volume velocity waveform. Inspect glottal pulse symmetry and closing phase derivatives.
visualTells: Symmetrical sinusoidal glottal pulses instead of natural steep closing slope
Phase inversion anomalies across stereo channels
Clicking and metallic micro-pops at phoneme transition boundaries

indicators.name: Codec Transcoding & Compression Artifact History
indicators.mechanism: Audio passed through multiple messaging apps (WhatsApp, Telegram) undergoes specific lossy compression (Opus, AAC, AMR). Examining codec frame headers reveals whether an audio clip was recorded live or re-encoded.
indicators.detectionProtocol: Analyze MP4/OGG/AAC container atom structures and frame bitrate allocations. Identify multi-generation transcoding signatures.
visualTells: Low-bitrate AMR container wrapping an ostensibly high-fidelity studio recording
Nested metadata tags indicating export from desktop audio workstations (DAWs)
Discontinuous timestamps in stream packet framing

indicators.name: Facial Landmark Boundary Warping & Temporal Flickering
indicators.mechanism: Face-swapping neural pipelines (e.g., DeepFaceLab, SimSwap) process video frame-by-frame or in short sliding windows, introducing boundary seam warping, micro-jitters, and skin tone flickering across temporal transitions.
indicators.detectionProtocol: Extract 68 facial landmark coordinates across sequential frames. Compute velocity delta vectors and color variance along the jawline and forehead blending mask perimeters.
visualTells: Flickering blur along the jawline perimeter when the subject turns their head past 45 degrees
Sudden loss of wrinkles or moles between consecutive video frames
Ghosting and double-edge halos around eyeglasses frames or collar lines

indicators.name: Physiological Invariants: Blink Dynamics & Remote Photoplethysmography (rPPG)
indicators.mechanism: Human blinking follows strict neuro-muscular duration curves (100ms to 400ms duration, 15 to 20 blinks per minute). Furthermore, blood volume pulses in facial micro-vessels cause subtle, imperceptible skin color fluctuations (rPPG) that deepfakes fail to synthesize.
indicators.detectionProtocol: Track eye aspect ratio (EAR) over time to count blink frequency. Apply spatial-temporal Eulerian Video Magnification (EVM) to detect blood pulse signals on the forehead and cheeks.
visualTells: Complete absence of natural blinking over a 60-second monologue
Incomplete, half-closed eyelid twitches occurring at unnatural 2-second intervals
Absence of rhythmic cardiac pulse chrominance signals in facial skin regions

indicators.name: Lip-Sync Phoneme-Viseme Geometric Synchronization
indicators.mechanism: When humans speak, specific phonemes require distinct mouth shapes (visemes) such as bilabial lip closure for /p/, /b/, and /m/ or labiodental teeth contact for /f/ and /v/. AI-driven dubbing pipelines frequently fail tight temporal synchronization.
indicators.detectionProtocol: Cross-correlate audio phoneme transcript timestamps with mouth aperture distance curves. Measure latency offsets between audio plosives and visual lip closures.
visualTells: Pronouncing 'P' or 'B' with open lips without physical bilabial contact
Teeth and tongue remaining stationary while dental consonants are articulated
Mouth opening motion lagging or leading audio track by more than 120 milliseconds

indicators.name: Volumetric Lighting & Neural Head Avatar Surface Normals
indicators.mechanism: Neural Radiance Field (NeRF) and 3D Gaussian Splatting avatars project 3D geometry onto 2D screens, creating subtle distortion in surface normal reflections as the subject rotates in perspective.
indicators.detectionProtocol: Estimate 3D facial mesh normals from monocular video and compare light gradient vectors against known background light sources.
visualTells: Nose bridge shadow failing to elongate when head turns away from the light source
Teeth appearing flat and two-dimensional inside the oral cavity
Hair strands remaining rigidly rigid without natural inertial physics during head movement

indicators.name: Perplexity & Burstiness Flatlining
indicators.mechanism: Large Language Models generate text by sampling from token probability distributions, producing uniformly low perplexity (predictability) and low burstiness (sentence length variation). Human writing is characterized by high burstiness: short punchy sentences interspersed with complex clauses.
indicators.detectionProtocol: Compute cross-entropy perplexity using a reference base model (e.g. GPT-2 / LLaMA) and calculate the standard deviation of sentence lengths and token rarity scores across the document.
visualTells: Uniform sentence lengths (almost every sentence contains 18 to 24 words)
Near-zero variance in token log-probabilities across entire multi-paragraph essays
Absence of idiosyncratic typos, colloquial idioms, or specialized local slang

indicators.name: Hedging Inflation, Sycophancy & Cliché Density
indicators.mechanism: RLHF (Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback) conditions language models to adopt safe, balanced, and sycophantic rhetorical boilerplate with predictable transition phrases ('It is important to remember', 'In conclusion, while X has benefits, Y presents challenges').
indicators.detectionProtocol: Scan text against statistical lexicons of LLM filler phrases and calculate the density of balanced hedging clauses per 1,000 words.
visualTells: High frequency of signature transition tropes ('Delve into', 'Tapestry of', 'Testament to', 'Beacon of hope')
Rigid tripartite essay structures (Intro -> Three balanced points -> Summary conclusion)
Compulsive neutrality that refuses to take a definitive empirical stance

indicators.name: Hallucinatory Factual Certainty & Phantom Citations
indicators.mechanism: LLMs hallucinate realistic-sounding bibliographic citations, scientific journal DOIs, and legal case precedents by stitching together plausible academic names and keywords without real-world ground truth.
indicators.detectionProtocol: Extract all named entities, journal names, DOI numbers, and statutory case citations. Execute automated validation against CrossRef, PubMed, and LexisNexis databases.
visualTells: Citing 'Journal of Advanced Clinical Cardiology, Vol 44 (2022)' with a non-existent DOI
Attributing quotes from historical figures using modern 21st-century idioms
Synthesizing court case names combining real judge names with fictional docket numbers

indicators.name: Stylometric Authorship Invariants & Syntactic Fingerprinting
indicators.mechanism: Human authors possess unique, persistent stylometric signatures: function word distributions (prepositions, conjunctions), punctuation habits (semicolons, em-dashes), and vocabulary richness (Type-Token Ratio).
indicators.detectionProtocol: Perform Delta stylometric analysis comparing the disputed text against a verified baseline corpus of the claimed author's authentic writings.
visualTells: Drastic departure from the author's historical function word distribution vector
Sudden disappearance of author's characteristic grammatical eccentricities
Vocabulary diversity collapsing to generic middle-frequency English

forensicTriageChecklist.title: Provenance & Ingestion Hash Verification
forensicTriageChecklist.action: Calculate SHA-256 hash of original file immediately upon receipt and archive on immutable storage.
forensicTriageChecklist.expectedEvidence: Cryptographic hash digest matching initial capture state.

forensicTriageChecklist.title: Container Metadata & EXIF Analysis
forensicTriageChecklist.action: Extract raw byte headers, EXIF/ID3/C2PA tags, software creator signatures, and creation timestamps.
forensicTriageChecklist.expectedEvidence: Presence or absence of authentic camera/sensor tags and C2PA signing certificates.

forensicTriageChecklist.title: Multi-Engine Reverse Search Triangulation
forensicTriageChecklist.action: Query Google, Yandex, Bing, TinEye, and CrossRef to find earliest web appearances and original contexts.
forensicTriageChecklist.expectedEvidence: Historical archive match disproving claim of breaking novelty.

forensicTriageChecklist.title: Frequency Domain & Spectral Inspection
forensicTriageChecklist.action: Run 2D Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) for imagery or 2048-point linear spectrogram for audio assets.
forensicTriageChecklist.expectedEvidence: Detection of Nyquist frequency cutoffs, GAN lattice spikes, or vocoder harmonic voids.

forensicTriageChecklist.title: Physical & Environmental Physics Verification
forensicTriageChecklist.action: Calculate solar shadow azimuth (SunCalc), room reverberation decay (RT60), and facial lighting gradients.
forensicTriageChecklist.expectedEvidence: Confirmation of physical lighting consistency or proof of contradictory ray vectors.

forensicTriageChecklist.title: Physiological & Anatomical Landmark Check
forensicTriageChecklist.action: Inspect eye blinking rate (EAR), skin blood volume pulse (rPPG), earlobe geometry, and phoneme-viseme sync.
forensicTriageChecklist.expectedEvidence: Biological pulse confirmation or artificial facial warping detection.

forensicTriageChecklist.title: Cryptographic Attestation & Reporting
forensicTriageChecklist.action: Compile forensic findings into standardized W3C JSON-LD attestation and sign with analyst DID key.

sampleCases.title: Forged Defense Ministry Emergency Deployment Directive
detectedArtifacts: Calibri font non-compliance on official letterhead
Error Level Analysis (ELA) reveals bright glowing bounding box around signature block
EXIF metadata author is 'User_Desktop_Win11' created 6 hours prior
sampleCases.groundTruth: Fabricated document created by adversary psy-ops unit using Photoshop and scanned letterhead template.

sampleCases.title: Synthetic CEO Audio Wire Transfer Authorization
detectedArtifacts: Brick-wall spectral energy cutoff at exactly 12.0kHz
Pitch jitter across vowels < 0.08% indicating text-to-speech vocoder synthesis
Zero room reverberation (RT60 = 0.0s) heard over simulated cell phone background noise
sampleCases.groundTruth: AI voice clone generated using commercial elevenlabs voice engine to attempt unauthorized corporate wire fraud.

sampleCases.title: Polling Warehouse Mail-In Ballot Shredding Video
detectedArtifacts: Contradictory solar shadow vectors between worker figures (45 deg) and building fixtures (130 deg)
Zero natural eye blinks over 45-second actor monologue
Mouth opening lags audio plosives /p/ and /b/ by 180 milliseconds
sampleCases.groundTruth: Staged synthetic video combining paid actors, AI lip-sync dubbing, and fake prop ballot forms.

sampleCases.title: Anonymous Whistleblower Manifesto on Secret Climate Geoengineering
detectedArtifacts: Perplexity cross-entropy score flatlined at 12.4 with near-zero burstiness
High density of LLM transition tropes ('tapestry of deception', 'delve into', 'it is important to remember')
Phantom citations referencing fictitious 2024 studies with non-existent DOI numbers
sampleCases.groundTruth: Synthetic essay generated via GPT-4 prompt to seed viral climate conspiracy theories.
